releaseNotes:
Official Update v1.3.13:
- Call History & Phone Sales: Instant incoming caller identification with customer details and phone sales KPI metrics.
- Missed Call Tracking: High-visibility red alert badges and 1-click callback action for missed customer inquiries.
- 1-Click Re-Order: Automatically loads the caller's previous order items directly into the register cart.
- Department Management View: Expanded full-screen table layout eliminating nested scrollbars for smoother navigation.
- Network Caller ID Sync: Real-time WebSocket broadcasting across all checkout stations.
- Clean virgin database setup with zero customer-specific data.
